initialExecution.error: ENOENT on an executable JavaScript href template mistaken for a static local file path

staticDiagnosis.cause: The href regex scanned complete HTML including executable script bodies containing generated link templates.
staticDiagnosis.intendedCorrection: Exclude script bodies before static markup href checks. Keep parsed module file/doc checks and all actual local static href checks.
